title: Chapter 1294 - 39: Unfathomable Power

Chapter 1294 - 39: Unfathomable Power

Chapter 1294: Chapter 39: Unfathomable Power

"’Infinite Void’ Sixth Layer..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Six thousand years ago, he had achieved the fifth layer of this inheritance, stepping into the sixth layer.

The sixth layer is also the upper limit of this inheritance. As for the seventh layer? Even the creator of the inheritance, a temporal lifeform, never achieved it; it’s merely a theoretical realm.

"What I’ve cultivated in the ’Infinite Void’ has already transcended the inheritance itself."

Lin Yuan mused, originally the ultimate goal of the ’Infinite Void’ was the Chaos Void.

But now Lin Yuan’s inner universe has the ultimate goal of the legendary perfect world.

For this, Lin Yuan absorbed the perfection and advantages of the first and second Origin Worlds of Chaos Void, eventually forming his current inner universe.

"Perhaps my current inner universe’s limit is not the seventh layer, but the eighth, ninth, or even tenth layers."

Lin Yuan thought silently, after achieving the sixth layer, the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance held little guidance for him, the path ahead required him to forge and create.

This is the path every strong person must walk; Lin Yuan’s Martial Arts Evolution Road is also how it came to be.

"My current strength..."

Lin Yuan was still somewhat uncertain.

Ten thousand years ago, he had little concept of his own strength, because not even a regular Invincible Great Saint of the Chaos Void could withstand even one of his moves.

And after ten thousand years of cultivation, Lin Yuan experienced another qualitative leap in various aspects, the sixth layer of ’Infinite Void’, the second layer of Chaotic Taiji Dao, among others.

Each aspect’s improvement would exponentially increase Lin Yuan’s strength.

What’s more, they combine together.

"The stronger the foundation accumulated, the more the leap when breaking through to the thirteenth stage."

Lin Yuan thought internally.

Breaking through from the eleventh stage to the twelfth involves infusion from the Chaos Void Origin.

The amount of infusion depends on the accumulation and foundation of the lifeform itself.

The breakthrough from the twelfth stage to the thirteenth is the same, so each birth of a temporal lifeform in the Chaos Void will cause phenomena spreading across thousands of Void Domains.

"I just wonder, when the time comes, can the Chaos Void Origin bear the infusion for me?"

Lin Yuan’s thoughts scattered.

With his current foundational accumulation, if he really successfully steps into the thirteenth stage, the Origin he could bear, without emptying the Chaos Void, would be equivalent to the total infused into dozens, even hundreds, of temporal lifeforms.

And even more.

Could the Chaos Void truly fill him at that time?

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan drifted along the Chaos Qi, arriving at a desolate void.

"It’s here."

Lin Yuan observed for a moment, then raised his hand and sliced.

In an instant, time and space were split apart, and a Postnatal Universe was forming vast and mighty.

The Postnatal Universe, different from the inner universe, was created by a supreme Great Saint, independent of the Great Saint himself.

Even if the supreme Great Saint fell and died, the Postnatal Universe would not collapse.

Of course, the Postnatal Universe cannot do as the inner universe does, able to exist as long as the cultivator lives.

The Postnatal Universe, like a natural-born universe, will have a day of collapse, and its collapse will be total, unlike a natural-born universe which can regenerate after a great destruction.

The Xuanhuang Universe opened by His Majesty the Xuanhuang was like this, nearing collapse after millions of Cosmic Eras, finally coming forth due to the edge of time-space destruction.

"Creating a Postnatal Universe, experiencing a genesis, is also a way to refine one’s understanding of rules and the Dao."

Lin Yuan watched the Postnatal Universe gradually form, with many rules and principles beginning to operate, while he began setting up the environment he desired.

"Moreover, this Postnatal Universe can serve as a base for human civilization as well."

"Even in extreme situations, if I become trapped in a temporal cycle, it won’t be immediate extinction."

Lin Yuan planned far ahead, at this point, he needed to prepare certain things.

Such as preparing a fallback for human civilization?

While Lin Yuan was present, no force in the Chaos Void dared provoke human civilization.

But if he became trapped in a temporal cycle?

The Profound Xuanhuang line and the Magic Jade Tower line were both precedents.

Lin Yuan naturally wanted to prepare more contingencies.

After all, his rise was too rapid.

Human civilization couldn’t keep up with him at all.

Until now, not even a single Chaos Realm has been born.

"With my methods, there’s no need to arrange within those natural-born universes."

Lin Yuan looked at the already mostly formed Postnatal Universe.

Even for an Invincible Great Saint, the Postnatal Universe they opened will eventually collapse one day.

So those Great Saints typically set up arrangements within the natural-born universe to ensure their inheritance wouldn’t die out with the collapse of the Postnatal Universe.

For instance, his home universe’s Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and the Robber Clan’s hut.

The natural-born universe, protected by the Chaos Void, is absolutely safe, constantly regenerating, serving as the ideal guarantee for the continuous inheritance of power.

But Lin Yuan didn’t need such troubles.

Because with Lin Yuan’s current mastery and application of time and space, the Postnatal Universe he opened basically wouldn’t have a day of collapse, able to coexist with the Chaos Void.

The Postnatal Universe not collapsing, human civilization would have an absolutely safe base, securing the legacy of human civilization through generations with some additional restrictive methods.

If the Chaos Void were to be destroyed?

If that day truly comes, temporal lifeforms would be forced into dimensional gaps, where everything inside would be annihilated.

And these backup plans were Lin Yuan’s worst-case scenario, based on his inability to break through the temporal cycle.

In fact, according to the timeline observed by the six ancestors of the first Origin World, Lin Yuan’s hope of successfully reaching the thirteenth stage was still very high.

Ten thousand years have passed, and the six ancestors have mostly let go of everything, constantly observing more of Lin Yuan’s future timelines, and none have shown him trapped in a temporal cycle.

...

Galaxy Chaos Continent.

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

Xuanyuan Supreme and other supreme beings came to pay respects.

Since Lin Yuan, the human civilization group has given birth to over twenty Path Splitting Realms.

However, these Path Splitting Realms, in status, naturally couldn’t compare with the nine supreme beings like Xia Qin Supreme.

The current cultivation environment for human civilization is too generous; during the home universe era, the human civilization struggled against the Myriad Clans, with supreme beings born amidst the blood rain.

"Galaxy, what do you want from us?"

Xia Qin Supreme looked at Lin Yuan and couldn’t help but ask.

Since entering the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan, the pillar of the group, managed almost nothing.

Gathering them all here now clearly wasn’t for a small matter.

"I have created thirty-three Postnatal Universes, scattered throughout the Chaos Void, extract some evolutionary beings to send inside."

"Keep these thirty-three Postnatal Universes confidential, don’t let it leak outside, and choose the evolutionary beings to send in as much as possible from the first and second layers."

Lin Yuan said.

The thirty-three Postnatal Universes were Lin Yuan’s preparation for the human civilization, representing the ultimate foundation.

According to the rules Lin Yuan set, once he attempted the thirteenth stage, these Universes could only be exited, not entered.

Not only could one not enter, even human civilization’s evolutionary beings couldn’t lock onto the precise location coordinates of these thirty-three Postnatal Universes, as they were fused into the deepest part of the Chaos Void, no Invincible Great Saint could approach.

Only out, never in, and never facing a great destruction, the Postnatal Universes will continuously provide new blood for human civilization from the outside.

"Galaxy, what is this for?"

Xuanyuan Supreme faintly sensed something off.

Specifically creating thirty-three Postnatal Universes and keeping it unspoken externally.

It all seemed like making arrangements for an aftermath.

The other supreme beings also looked at Lin Yuan with slight concern.

At the same time, they had a faint suspicion in their hearts.

The only possible reason for the galaxy Great Saint to make such arrangements is that matter—

Attempting the thirteenth stage.

"Don’t worry."

Lin Yuan’s expression was calm as he glanced at the supreme beings.

These supreme beings all came from his home universe, having watched Lin Yuan rise from weakness to invincibility, feeling not just reverence but kinship as well.

So Lin Yuan comforted them slightly:

"This is merely preparation for the worst-case scenario."
